about.metaTitle: About Steve Hopwood | Corsair Tactical Solutions
about.metaDescription: Meet Steve Hopwood — U.S. Navy Veteran, President & CEO of Corsair Tactical Solutions. Certified firearms instructor, security trainer, and co-founder of the Alliance Training Network with decades of operational experience.

hero.imageAlt: Steve Hopwood — Firearms and Security Instructor
hero.subtitle: Navy Veteran · Certified Instructor · Security & Firearms Training Leader · President & CEO, Corsair Tactical Solutions
hero.cardImageAlt: Treinamento profissional em armas de fogo

profile.imageAlt: Steve Hopwood — Corsair Tactical Solutions Instructor
profile.name: Steve Hopwood
profile.paragraph1: Steve Hopwood is a United States Navy veteran, certified firearms and tactical instructor, and Texas-licensed private security professional with decades of operational experience in high-risk and high-consequence environments.
profile.paragraph2: His professional foundation was forged in the United States Navy, where mission discipline, situational awareness, command structure, and risk management were not theoretical — they were mandatory. That military framework continues to inform his leadership philosophy and training methodology.
profile.paragraph3: As the President and CEO of Corsair Tactical Solutions Security and Training and co-founder of the Alliance Training Network, Steve has built a comprehensive training and security organization trusted by individuals, families, churches, businesses, and security professionals across Texas.
profile.paragraph4: A committed defender of the Second Amendment, Steve believes that preparedness is a moral and practical responsibility. His programs are designed to empower everyday Texans and security professionals alike — equipping them with the skills, mindset, and confidence to respond effectively when it matters most.
profile.scheduleInfo: Call or email — flexible scheduling available.

philosophySection.label: Steve's Approach
philosophySection.title: Training With Professional Excellence
philosophySection.description: Steve's instruction is built on the understanding that effective response under stress is the product of deliberate, structured training. At Corsair, we focus on equipping individuals, families, churches, and organizations to become their own first responders.
philosophySection.coreQuote: "You do not rise to the occasion — you fall to the level of your training."

mental.title: Mental Preparedness

situational.desc: Recognizing threats before they escalate is the foundation of personal safety and professional security.

firearms.title: Firearms Proficiency

firstAid.title: First Aid & Trauma Response
firstAid.desc: Being equipped to provide emergency care — Stop the Bleed, CPR, AED — is an essential component of preparedness.

conflict.title: Conflict Avoidance & De-escalation
conflict.desc: The best defensive outcome is one that never requires force. Avoidance, awareness, and de-escalation skills are taught at every level.

experienceSection.label: Proven Leadership
experienceSection.title: Experience That Matters
experienceSection.paragraph1: Having operated in volatile environments — both during military service and in civilian protective operations — Steve understands a core truth: training saves lives.
experienceSection.paragraph2: His leadership is built on safety, discipline, readiness, and practical instruction. Every course at Corsair reflects real-world knowledge, not just textbook theory.
experienceSection.paragraph3: Corsair's team is backed by operational experience across multiple disciplines, ensuring every student receives instruction grounded in real-world application.

casilda.imageAlt: Dr. Casilda Maxwell — Corsair Tactical Solutions
credentials: Certified R.A.D. Instructor — RAD System of Self Defense
casilda.bio: Dr. Casilda Maxwell brings a unique and invaluable perspective to The Alliance Training Team. As a clinical psychologist and certified USCCA instructor, she bridges the gap between mental preparedness and physical defense. Owner of LowKey Defense, Dr. Maxwell specializes in women's self-defense, the R.A.D. System, and less lethal defense strategies. Her expertise in Krav Maga and firearms purchase consultations ensures students receive holistic, confidence-building training tailored to their needs.

shannon.name: Shannon Gulley
credentials: Certified R.A.D. Instructor — RAD System of Self Defense
Owner — Goody Box Self Defense LLC — FFL
shannon.bio: Shannon Gulley is a dedicated self-defense instructor and advocate committed to empowering individuals — especially women — with the skills and confidence to protect themselves. As a USCCA Certified Home Defense Instructor and certified R.A.D. Instructor through the RAD System of Self Defense, Shannon brings both technical expertise and genuine compassion to every class she teaches. She is the owner of Goody Box Self Defense LLC, a licensed FFL firearms dealer, and serves as Assistant-Program Director for the Anti-Tracking Organization. A passionate domestic violence advocate, Shannon specializes in women's self-defense and less lethal defense strategies, ensuring that students of all experience levels feel safe, supported, and prepared.

churchSafety.introStatement: We begin with non-lethal de-escalation training, volunteer safety protocols, and medical readiness. servicesSection.title: Church Safety Services
servicesSection.description: Comprehensive safety and security solutions tailored for churches and houses of worship of all sizes.

safetyPlanning.title: House of Worship Safety Planning
safetyPlanning.description: We work with pastors, ministry leaders, and safety directors to develop or improve your church security plan. Our approach begins with understanding your congregation, facility, and current processes before making recommendations.

assessments.title: Church Security Assessments
assessments.description: A thorough evaluation of your facility's vulnerabilities — from entry points and parking lots to interior access and emergency exits. We document findings and deliver a prioritized action plan with clear next steps.

volunteerTraining.title: Volunteer Safety Team Training
volunteerTraining.description: Your volunteers are the backbone of your church safety program. We train them in situational awareness, communication protocols, threat recognition, and coordinated response — giving them the confidence to act when it matters.

walkthroughs.title: Facility Walkthroughs
walkthroughs.description: Our security professionals conduct a comprehensive walkthrough of your entire campus — sanctuary, fellowship halls, classrooms, children's areas, and parking. Every corner is assessed for risk and improvement.

deEscalation.title: Non-Lethal De-Escalation
deEscalation.description: Not every threat requires force. Our team trains your staff and volunteers in verbal de-escalation, conflict resolution, and situational management techniques that can defuse a situation before it escalates.

medical.title: Medical Readiness
medical.description: We help your team prepare for medical emergencies — from basic first aid and AED placement to mass casualty response planning. Being prepared saves lives in the critical minutes before EMS arrives.

emergencyPlanning.title: Emergency Planning
emergencyPlanning.description: Comprehensive emergency response plans covering active threat, fire, severe weather, medical emergency, and evacuation scenarios. We develop, document, and train your team on every protocol.

onsiteSecurity.title: Onsite Security for Services & Events
onsiteSecurity.description: Professional armed security officers for weekly services, special events, revivals, and conferences. Our team provides a reassuring presence that allows your congregation to worship in peace.

processSection.title: Our Process
processSection.description: A structured approach to securing your house of worship — from first consultation to ongoing protection.

step1.title: Initial Consultation
step1.desc: We meet with church leadership to understand your concerns, current safety measures, and goals for your security program.

step2.title: Facility Assessment
step2.desc: An extensive walkthrough of your campus to identify vulnerabilities, assess current processes, and evaluate physical security measures.

step3.title: Scope & Recommendations
step3.desc: We deliver a detailed scope document with findings, prioritized impacts, and opportunities for improvement — along with a clear timeline for next steps.

step4.title: Implementation & Training
step4.desc: We help implement safety plans, train volunteer teams, conduct drills, and provide ongoing support to keep your program effective and current.

onsiteSection.title: Professional Security for Every Service
onsiteSection.paragraph1: Corsair also offers onsite security patrol for weekly, weekday, and special services. Our Level III and Level IV certified officers — many of whom are veterans and former law enforcement — are trained specifically in house of worship security protocols.
onsiteSection.paragraph2: We can assist with training your internal church safety teams and provide ongoing safety training to ensure your program remains effective and current. Consulting and security solutions — let's talk and ensure your plans are in place.

general1.q: Do I have to have a firearm to attend a class?
general1.a: No — you can rent a firearm and ammunition directly from Corsair Tactical Solutions. Just let us know in advance when you book so we can have the right equipment ready for you.

general2.q: Do you instruct outside of Texas?
general2.a: Yes! Steve Hopwood can provide instruction in all 50 states. However, Texas License to Carry (LTC) certification is only valid for the State of Texas and must be completed here.

general3.q: Can you be booked for private classes or parties?
general3.a: Absolutely. Corsair can provide training for private parties, private group meetings, corporate events, church safety teams, and any special training event. Contact Steve to discuss your needs.

general4.q: Where can I find Corsair's reviews?
general4.a: You can find our reviews on Google and ShootingClasses.com. We maintain a 5-star rating across all platforms. Students consistently praise our patient, thorough instruction and welcoming atmosphere for beginners.

general5.q: What should I wear to a training class?
general5.a: Wear comfortable, weather-appropriate clothing and closed-toe shoes (no sandals or open-toe shoes). Avoid low-cut tops — hot brass casings can find their way in. A hat with a brim is recommended for outdoor ranges. Eye and ear protection will be provided if you don't have your own.

ltc1.q: Do you provide training prior to a certification class?
ltc1.a: Yes. Students can call and book a private session before attending the LTC class. LTC students must have basic firearm handling experience. If you don't have experience yet, contact Corsair so a training plan can be created to help you succeed. This is a journey and we are here to assist.

ltc2.q: What do I need to bring to the Texas LTC class?
ltc2.a: You'll need a valid government-issued photo ID, a semi-automatic handgun or revolver (.22 caliber minimum), 50 rounds of ammunition, and eye and ear protection. Firearm and ammo rental is available — just let us know when booking.

ltc3.q: How long does it take to get my LTC after the class?
ltc3.a: After passing the class, you submit your application to the Texas Department of Public Safety (DPS) directly. Processing typically takes 2–6 weeks depending on DPS volume. Your instructor will walk you through the application process.

ltc4.q: Can I take the Texas LTC class online?
ltc4.a: Yes! The classroom portion of the Texas LTC can be completed online through our approved Online Texas LTC Assessment. You'll still need to complete the shooting proficiency portion in person at the range. The online option is perfect for busy schedules — complete the classroom work at your own pace, then schedule your range qualification.

ltc5.q: What is the LTC shooting proficiency test?
ltc5.a: The proficiency test consists of 50 rounds fired from a B-27 target at varying distances (3, 7, and 15 yards). You must score a minimum of 175 out of 250 points (70%) to pass. Our instructors will walk you through exactly what to expect and ensure you're well-prepared before test day.

training1.q: I'm a complete beginner — is that okay?
training1.a: Completely okay! Many of our students have never touched a firearm before. Our beginner courses are designed to be judgment-free, safe, and supportive. Steve will start with the absolute basics and make sure you feel comfortable before ever handling a firearm.

training2.q: Do you offer women's only courses?
training2.a: Yes. Corsair offers Women's Only courses designed to provide a comfortable, supportive environment for women new to firearms. Contact us to ask about scheduled women's classes or to set up a private session.

training3.q: What security certifications do you offer?
training3.a: Corsair offers Level II (Unarmed), Level III (Armed Security Officer), and Level IV (Bodyguard / Personal Protection Officer) certification courses meeting Texas DPS Private Security Bureau requirements. Contact us for current scheduling and pricing.

training4.q: Do you teach NRA or USCCA curriculum courses?
training4.a: Yes. Steve Hopwood is a certified NRA Instructor (Pistol Shooting Course) and USCCA Instructor (Concealed Carry Home Defense). Both NRA and USCCA course options are available — contact us for scheduling.

training5.q: What is the difference between a private lesson and a group class?
training5.a: Private lessons are 1-on-1 with Steve, fully customized to your goals, pace, and skill level. You get undivided attention and can focus on exactly what you want to learn. Group classes follow a set curriculum, cost less per person, and are great for social learning. Many students start with a private lesson and then join group classes with confidence.

training6.q: Do I need to take a beginner class before the LTC?
training6.a: It depends on your experience level. If you have never fired a handgun before, we strongly recommend taking our First Shots or Basic Handgun Skills class first. The LTC class assumes basic firearm handling knowledge. Not sure? Call us and we'll help you figure out the right path.

pricing1.q: How do I book a course?
pricing1.a: You can book by calling 214-335-6652, emailing corsairtacticalsolutions@gmail.com, or using the contact form on this website. Steve will confirm your spot and send you all the details you need.

pricing2.q: Is payment required to reserve my spot?
pricing2.a: No payment is required upfront to reserve your spot. Payment is collected at the range on the day of your training session. This makes it easy to book without any financial risk.

pricing3.a: Course registrations are non-refundable. If you are unable to attend your scheduled class, please contact us as soon as possible. Your registration will automatically be transferred to the next available class for the same course at no additional charge. See our full Policies page for details.

pricing4.a: Yes! Group training and party bookings are available at discounted rates. Contact Steve directly at 214-335-6652 to discuss group pricing and custom scheduling for your team, family, or organization.
